item.title: In one of their last votes before November, Senate GOP blocks effort to end Iran war
item.description: The vote on a war powers resolution introduced by Democrats came at a moment when some Republicans have begun to distance themselves from President Trump over the ongoing conflict.

item.description: What can we expect from the Trump-Xi summit? NPR's A Martinez asks Daniel Kritenbrink, an assistant Secretary of State for East Asian and Pacific affairs in the Biden administration.

item.title: Warren demands Trump officials explain removing a ban on interference in census data
item.description: Democratic Sen. Elizabeth Warren asked Trump officials to explain why the Census Bureau's parent agency cut a ban on political interference from its scientific integrity policy, as NPR first reported.

item.title: Could the White House try its press ban again? A press freedom expert explains
item.description: A federal judge's ruling restored CNN, MS Now and Politico's access to the White House. Gabe Rottman says better procedure alone may not resolve the broader First Amendment fight.

item.title: Journalists for CNN, MS NOW and Politico return to the White House upon judge's orders
item.description: A federal judge ordered the Trump administration on Thursday to temporarily restore access to CNN, MS NOW and Politico, after they were banned from covering White House events by President Trump.
